blocks.text: Your Mac is your primary tool. You need Slack to be fast. Start by learning the core keyboard shortcuts. Press ⌘ + / to open the cheat sheet inside Slack. This is the fastest way to see every command available to you. Navigation is the key to speed. Use ⌘ + K to open the Quick Switcher. Type the name of a channel or person to jump there immediately. This saves you from clicking through lists of channels.

Lazur lives in the notch of your Mac. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything on your screen. If you are looking at a long thread and need to find a specific update, ask Lazur to summarize it. If you need to find a button, ask Lazur where it is. It will draw a circle around the object. You never have to hunt for small icons again.

items: Use threads for every conversation. This keeps your main channel view clean.
Mute channels that are not urgent. Right-click the channel name and select Mute.
Set your status when you are in a meeting or on a call. Use ⌘ + Shift + Y to open the status menu.
Use ⌘ + Shift + A to open the Unreads view if you fall behind.
Schedule messages for later if you are working with teams in different time zones.

blocks.text: Search is where most coordinators lose time. Use modifiers to narrow your results. Type from:@name to find messages from a specific carrier. Use has:link to find shared documents. If you need to search inside a specific channel, use ⌘ + F while in that channel. This restricts your search to that conversation only.

Exceptions are the most stressful part of your job. When a shipment is delayed, you need to act fast. Use the save for later feature to flag messages that require follow-up. Click the bookmark icon or use the menu. This creates a list of tasks you can work through during your quiet time. Do not leave these items in your main feed.
If you are overwhelmed, type /dnd to pause all notifications. This gives you time to focus on complex reports without constant interruptions.
blocks.title: Focus time

blocks.text: Many logistics tasks are repetitive. You send the same shipping updates every day. Use Slack snippets or your own text expansion tools to save time. If you use Lazur, you can dictate your responses. Hold fn to start dictating. Speak clearly and Lazur will type the text for you. This is perfect for quick status updates.

Notifications can break your concentration. Go to Preferences with ⌘ + , to manage your settings. Choose to receive notifications only for direct messages and mentions. This prevents you from being distracted by general channel chatter. Check your notification schedule to ensure you are not bothered outside of your work hours.

faq.question: How do I find a message I lost?
faq.answer: Use ⌘ + G to open the search bar. Use modifiers like from: or in: to narrow your search.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points, guides, and explains. It does not perform clicks or operate other apps for you.

faq.question: How do I keep my Slack clean?
faq.answer: Use threads for replies, mute unnecessary channels, and use the Unreads view to stay on top of important messages.
